name: Goblin
ability: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.
wakes: Never. The ability is triggered by a public claim during the day.
interaction: Chooses nothing and is told nothing. When nominated, the player may publicly claim to be the Goblin before voting; the Storyteller announces the claim to the group and marks the Goblin CLAIMED.
drunk_or_poisoned: If the Goblin is drunk or poisoned when executed (after claiming that day), the ability does not trigger: the Goblin dies and the game continues. The claim itself is still a legal public statement.

jinxes.text: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.
If the Storyteller would gain the Goblin ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

rulings.text: The claim must be made when nominated, before votes, loudly enough for everyone to hear.
The claim only counts on the day it is made; a claim on an earlier day does not make a later execution win.
Any player may claim to be the Goblin; a non-Goblin who claims and is executed causes nothing and the game continues.
If the Goblin is executed without having claimed that day, the Goblin simply dies.
The ability needs only the execution, not the death: a claimed Goblin who is executed but survives (e.g. Devil's Advocate) still wins for their team.
